answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 940 aliases means 940 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. The signal test is the live device, the nebula test is the locked stake, and the prism test is the graded history no template can fake.
